extracted.stage: Litigant in person in ongoing divorce, no solicitor instructed
extracted.summary: Daniel is self-representing in a divorce and asks to borrow around £24,000 to instruct a solicitor, with roughly £136,000 of assets (house and pension) in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To look at it properly we still need a few details: where the proceedings are taking place, the date of any upcoming hearing, the name of the solicitor you intend to instruct (if you have one in mind), and a breakdown of the assets in dispute and how they are held. It would also help to know the current stage of the proceedings and whether any financial disclosure has been exchanged. Once we have that information a member of the team will review your enquiry and come back to you. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer of funding or as legal advice.
